name: Time To Decide / Over The Phone
original_name: 決着のとき / 受話器の向こうに
source:
Time To Decide:
After your best friend makes a girlfriend, you discover your true feelings for him. You've decided to confess your true feelings to him, but what will happen next...?

Over The Phone:
Here's a wild telephone sex story for gay men! One day, you stumbled upon him on the internet. Now, you talk with each other over the phone, but you still haven't met yet. However, something in his voice makes you incredibly horny...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040606184134fw_/http://www.rainbow-shoppers.com/en/www/list.cgi?id=G000518100026]Rainbow Shoppers[/url]]
translation:
做出决定的时间：
当你最好的朋友交了女朋友之后，你就会发现自己对他的真实感情。你决定向他坦白自己的真实感受，但接下来会发生什么……？

通过电话：
这是一个针对男同性恋者的疯狂电话性爱故事！有一天，你在互联网上偶然发现了他。现在，你们通过电话互相交谈，但你们还没有见过面。然而，他声音中的某些东西让你非常饥渴……
